title: einvoice conformance info (v1)
description: Machine-readable JSON Schema for the capability/introspection object emitted by `python3 -m einvoice info --json` (einvoice.cli). This is the fail-fast handshake a CI consumer reads BEFORE feeding invoices: it advertises the engine version, how many EN 16931 / XRechnung business rules are asserted, which output formats and validation profiles are available, the syntax-binding coverage counts, and the SHA-256 of the committed attestation document so a consumer can pin the exact trust artifact. The object carries no rule logic and is a pure projection of the engine's registries + attestation.json. Versioning policy: this $id is STABLE within v1 - additive, backward-compatible keys may be added without changing it; any BREAKING change to the info shape bumps the id to .../v2. NOTE: `version` is the einvoice PACKAGE version (it advances with releases, e.g. 0.1.0), so it is a free string here, NOT a const - the schema/shape version is carried by the $id path segment. Subschemas are inlined (no $ref) so the stdlib structural validator that guards this schema exercises every constraint.

attestation_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the committed attestation.json trust document; a consumer can pin this to detect an unexpected engine build.

coverage.description: Headline coverage counts: how many business rules are asserted and how much of each Schematron syntax binding is differentially proven.

total_asserted.description: Number of distinct business rules the engine actually asserts.

proven.description: Number of syntax-binding restrictions differentially proven to fire.

total.description: Total syntax-binding restrictions in the official artifact universe.

proven.description: Number of syntax-binding restrictions differentially proven to fire.

total.description: Total syntax-binding restrictions in the official artifact universe.

formats.description: The report output formats the CLI can emit (e.g. json, junit, sarif, github, gitlab, azure, html, badge, text).

profiles.description: The validation profiles available to select.

rule_count.description: Total number of business rules the engine asserts (mirrors coverage.business_rules.total_asserted).

version.description: The einvoice PACKAGE version string (advances with releases; not the schema version).
